name: Sika Injection-222
paste:
SIKA® INJECTION-222: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® Injection-222, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/8/sika-injection-222.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® Injection-222 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. Sika® Injection-222 is a single component flexible hydrophilic MDI based urethane injection grout. Sika® Injection-222 reacts with water to form a permanent flexible closed cell polyurethane seal.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® Injection-222 may only be used by experienced professionals.
    - Seal leaks in cracks
    - Seal leaks in joints
    - Stop active water flow
    - Seal leaks in concrete, masonry and brickwork

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® Injection-222
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Hydrophilic flexible polyurethane grout
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Environmentally friendly
    - Solvent and phthalate free
    - Reacts with fresh and sea water
    - Suitable for hydrostatic pressure environments
    - permanently flexible
    - single component- ready to use
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: MDI based urethane
    - Colour: yellow liquid
    - Density: 1.10 (g/cm3)
    - Viscosity: 150-400 mPa.s ( 21 °C)
2.5 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Tensile strength: 1.65MPa
    - Elongation: 120%
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Sika® Injection-222- 20kg pail
    - Shelf life: 12 months
    - Storage conditions: From date of production if stored properly in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +10°C and +30°C.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: Sika® Injection-222 can be mixed with water before injection to increase the free rise ratio and to quicken the rise time. The water:resin ratio typically used is from 1:1 up to 1:4.
4.3 Reaction time. Ratio 1:1 (Water:Resin)
    | Temperature (°C) | Cream Time | Rise Time (sec) | Free Rise Ratio |
    | (sec) |
    | 10 | 1 | 240 | 3x |
    | 20 | 1 | 150 | 2.5x |
    | 25 | 1 | 120 | 2.5x |
    | 30 | 1 | 80 | 2.5x |
    | Ratio between Water:Resin at 25°C |
    | Ratio | Cream Time (sec) | Rise Time (sec) | Free Rise Ratio |
    | 1:1 | 1 | 120 | 2.5x |
    | 1:2 | 1 | 130 | 3.5x |
    | 1:3 | 1 | 90 | 3.5x |
    | 1:4 | 1 | 80 | 3.5x |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® Injection-222, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/8/sika-injection-222.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sika Injection 222, version 09/04/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/p/MSDS%20Sika%20Injection-222%20GHS7.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Ecology, health and safety - Equipment. Sika® Injection-222 is typically injected by use of a single component pump that is designed for high pressure use.
6.4 Ecology, health and safety - Mixing. Sika® Injection-222 is ready to use from the pail. Make sure product is pre-conditioned before use to an optimum 20-25ºC. If product has crystallisation due to low temperature storage, indirect heating and mixing using a power drill mixer paddle may be required before use.
6.5 Ecology, health and safety - Cleaning of equipment. Please consult equipment/pump manufacturer for relative cleaning agent suitable for your individual equipment being used.
6.6 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.7 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.8 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
